summary: Defines SNMP managed objects for the SMDS Interface Protocol, used to connect to Switched Multimegabit Data Service networks. Here SIP means the SMDS Interface Protocol, not the later Session Initiation Protocol. It was replaced by RFC 1694.

eli5.summary: A list of dials and gauges for checking a connection to a high-speed data service. It makes the readings look the same on any maker's equipment.
